subject: the crispy chicken between the workouts
body:
Hey Abdul,

You put "Home made crispy chicken with mushroom pasta Parmesan cheese" between the workouts. People follow you all day, not just the hour.

Deciding who is worth your time is most of my job. 30 of the ones I picked signed this year.

10 names are sitting in a doc with your name on it. I'd start with those.

15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.

Haytham

ps: I read your work before I wrote this one.

subject: psychology felt kind of soulless
body:
Hey Sophia,

You called psychology "kind of soulless" right before you found sound healing. You run the room you needed.

I fill rooms like yours. The last life coach I worked with booked 8 meetings in 5 weeks, 3 of them signed.

I pulled 10 names for you before writing this. Not a scraped list, people I'd actually start with.

Worth 15 minutes? You'll have the 10 within a day of us speaking, and I'll show you how I picked them.

Haytham

ps: a straight no is a fine answer, and costs you nothing.
